clauses.text:
)xecutive Orber
Mrs. Minnie D. Middleton, of the District of Columbia, who served as a
clerk in the War Department for a period of twelve years, may be reinstated
in the classified service and appointed to a clerkship at $900 in the Depart-
ment of State, notwithstanding the lapse of more than one year since her
separation from the service. Mrs. Middleton's service in the War Depart-
ment was faithful and efficient. She is at present employed upon the
temporary force of the State Department dealing with the relief of American
citizens abroad, and this order is issued upon the recommendation of the
Secretary of State, who considers it in the interest of the public service.
The Civil Service Commission does not concur in this recommendation.
